CHARACTER.IRONCLAD.name: The Ironclad
CHARACTER.IRONCLAD.description: The last soldier of the Ironclads. Crushes foes with sword and flame against his will.

CHARACTER.SILENT.name: The Silent
CHARACTER.SILENT.description: A huntress from outside the Spire. Ready to stab and poison anything in her way.

CHARACTER.DEFECT.name: The Defect
CHARACTER.DEFECT.description: An automaton eternally modifying itself to survive. Deploys Orb technology when it must fight.

CHARACTER.REGENT.name: The Regent
CHARACTER.REGENT.description: Heir to the Throne of Stars. Wields cosmic powers but his minions do the work.

CHARACTER.NECROBINDER.name: The Necrobinder
CHARACTER.NECROBINDER.description: A Spireborn lich who seeks revenge. Calls upon her trusty left hand, Osty, in combat.

ROOM.MONSTER.name: Enemy
ROOM.MONSTER.description: Hostile enemies reside in these rooms.

ROOM.ELITE.name: Elite
ROOM.ELITE.description: Powerful foes are in these rooms. Defeating them will reward you a Relic.

ROOM.REST.name: Rest Site
ROOM.REST.description: Stop by these rooms to Heal some HP or Upgrade a card.

ROOM.SHOP.name: Shop
ROOM.SHOP.description: The mysterious Merchant sells his wares in these rooms. Spend your well-earned Gold here!

ROOM.TREASURE.name: Treasure Room
ROOM.TREASURE.description: Relics and Gold can be found in these coveted rooms.

ROOM.EVENT.name: Event
ROOM.EVENT.description: Something unusual occurs in these rooms...

ROOM.UNKNOWN.name: Unknown
ROOM.UNKNOWN.description: An unknown room. Encounter an event, enemies, shop, or treasure.

POTION.ATTACK_POTION.name: Attack Potion
POTION.ATTACK_POTION.description: Choose 1 of 3 random Attack cards to add into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

POTION.FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.name: Fairy in a Bottle
POTION.FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.description: When your HP would be reduced to 0, instead this potion is discarded and you heal to 30% of your Max HP.

RELIC.BURNING_BLOOD.name: Burning Blood
RELIC.BURNING_BLOOD.description: At the end of combat, heal X HP.

RELIC.RING_OF_THE_SNAKE.name: Ring of the Snake
RELIC.RING_OF_THE_SNAKE.description: At the start of each combat, draw X additional cards.

RELIC.CRACKED_CORE.name: Cracked Core
RELIC.CRACKED_CORE.description: At the start of each combat, Channel X Lightning.

RELIC.DIVINE_RIGHT.name: Divine Right
RELIC.DIVINE_RIGHT.description: At the start of each combat, gain X.

RELIC.BOUND_PHYLACTERY.name: Bound Phylactery
RELIC.BOUND_PHYLACTERY.description: At the start of your turn, Summon X.

RELIC.ANCHOR.name: Anchor
RELIC.ANCHOR.description: Start each combat with X Block.

RELIC.BAG_OF_MARBLES.name: Bag of Marbles
RELIC.BAG_OF_MARBLES.description: At the start of each combat, apply X Vulnerable to ALL enemies.

RELIC.BLOOD_VIAL.name: Blood Vial
RELIC.BLOOD_VIAL.description: At the start of each combat, heal X HP.

RELIC.LANTERN.name: Lantern
RELIC.LANTERN.description: Start each combat with an additional X.

RELIC.ORICHALCUM.name: Orichalcum
RELIC.ORICHALCUM.description: If you end your turn without Block, gain X Block.

RELIC.KUNAI.name: Kunai
RELIC.KUNAI.description: Every time you play X Attacks in a single turn, gain X Dexterity.

RELIC.LETTER_OPENER.name: Letter Opener
RELIC.LETTER_OPENER.description: Every time you play X Skills in a single turn, deal X damage to ALL enemies.

RELIC.ORNAMENTAL_FAN.name: Ornamental Fan
RELIC.ORNAMENTAL_FAN.description: Every time you play X Attacks in a single turn, gain X Block.

RELIC.PEN_NIB.name: Pen Nib
RELIC.PEN_NIB.description: Every 10th Attack you play deals double damage.

RELIC.PANTOGRAPH.name: Pantograph
RELIC.PANTOGRAPH.description: At the start of each Boss combat, heal X HP.

RELIC.DOLLYS_MIRROR.name: Dolly's Mirror
RELIC.DOLLYS_MIRROR.description: Upon pickup, obtain an additional copy of a card in your Deck.

RELIC.ECTOPLASM.name: Ectoplasm
RELIC.ECTOPLASM.description: You can no longer gain Gold. Gain X at the start of each turn.

RELIC.MANGO.name: Mango
RELIC.MANGO.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by X.
